name: kebabstack-checks
description: Reproducible local checks for the kebab-stack monorepo

scripts.test:security: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/finance.test.mjs tests/crumbs.test.mjs tests/security.test.mjs tests/permissions.test.mjs tests/lifecycle.test.mjs tests/customer-support.test.mjs tests/oncall.test.mjs tests/oncall-response.test.mjs tests/oncall-reporting.test.mjs tests/oncall-compensation.test.mjs tests/oncall-calendar-status.test.mjs tests/oncall-regional-reminders.test.mjs tests/oncall-alerts.test.mjs tests/hardware-offboarding.test.mjs tests/trust-workspace.test.mjs tests/operations.test.mjs tests/displays.test.mjs
scripts.runtime:sync: node design/runtime/sync.mjs && python3 sdk/tools/sync-signin.py && python3 hub/tools/sync-sdk.py
scripts.runtime:check: node design/runtime/sync.mjs --check && python3 sdk/tools/sync-signin.py --check && python3 sdk/tools/check-sdk.py
